name: Makka Pakka 2
storyline:
You are trapped In the Night Garden. To escape alive, you must fulfill Makka Pakka's task. Darkness is taking over the vegetation, and your only companion is a dim lantern, along with the hope of making it out alive from this gloomy wilderness. Makka Pakka will appear at a random moment and begin to chase you across the map, distracting you from your main goal: collecting the 15 Makka Pakka trumpets. During this time, your sanity will decrease, causing you to experience "hallucinations" of something or someone. You don't know who it is, but they seem to be trying to make you lose focus at the perfect moment—a perfect time for Makka Pakka to catch you.

Will you be able to escape the forest alive?
